title: Hardcoded API key in REST command
description: API key sk-live-abc123def456 is hardcoded in the REST command header instead of using !secret.

title: Jinja2 float without default fallback
description: states('sensor.outdoor_temperature') | float will raise when the sensor is unavailable. Use float(0) or float(default).

title: Duplicate action key in automation
description: Two 'action:' keys in the same automation mapping (lines 131 and 143). The second silently overwrites the first, losing the alarm arm, lights off, and thermostat setback actions.

title: Automation trigger missing id field
description: Trigger lacks an id field, making trace debugging harder. Compare with other automations that include id on their triggers.
